task.title: Ad-hoc is direct sheep invocation
task.original: Ad-hoc must require nothing but instructions: no task, no worktree, no status.json. Move ad-hoc out of Nicki to the parent agent and delete --mode adhoc.

story: ad-hoc = direct sheep spawn · no task · no status write · parent agent dispatches · Nicki keeps normal + jump · --mode adhoc removed · archive always prefix/docs/archive/slug · start/close/status stay Nicki-only

decisions.decision: Direct sheep invocation by the parent agent, not a write mode on the task path.
Parent agent. Nicki keeps only normal and jump.

Removed from MODES and update-status.py; argparse rejects it.

open_questions: Skill/format now match the ad-hoc prompt for path/input: prefix + slug, no close-scope, no no-status ask, errors copy only when named. This second live test writes under docs/archive/adhoc-direct-sheep-invocation/ as required.
